import hashlib, json, pathlib, subprocess, sys, tempfile
base = pathlib.Path('products/services/merchant-v1-group-id-sample')
bundle = json.loads((base / 'executed-controls/runner-and-fixtures.json').read_text())
files = ('check.py', 'pass.csv', 'fail.csv')
assert all(isinstance(bundle[name], str) for name in files)
report = {'scope': 'Fictional offline controls with supplied family labels. Platform acceptance and buyer demand are unverified.', 'files': {}, 'runs': []}
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as directory:
    clean = pathlib.Path(directory)
    for name in files:
        data = bundle[name].encode('utf-8')
        (clean / name).write_bytes(data)
        report['files'][name] = hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()
    for name, expected in [('pass.csv', 0), ('fail.csv', 1)]:
        command = ['check.py', name]
        result = subprocess.run([sys.executable, *command], cwd=clean, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=10)
        report['runs'].append({'command': ['python3', *command], 'exit_code': result.returncode, 'expected_exit_code': expected, 'stdout': result.stdout, 'stderr': result.stderr})
    report['expected_exit_codes_observed'] = all(run['exit_code'] == run['expected_exit_code'] for run in report['runs'])
    destination = base / 'runnable-controls'
    destination.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    for name in files:
        (destination / name).write_bytes((clean / name).read_bytes())
    (destination / 'verification.json').write_text(json.dumps(report, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + '\n', encoding='utf-8')
print(json.dumps(report, ensure_ascii=False))
